text:
Alex M: starting canary push to customer-vpc-X. routing 5% -> canary-1, control plane shows queued updates
deploy-bot: deploy started for canary-1 at 2026-03-18T10:12:25Z
Priya S: seeing ack lag from private control plane (v1.3.7). propagation to site nodes stalled on addr pool B
Sam G: is this the same backpressure we saw last month? any connection errors in controlplane logs?
Jia L: logs show 'Ack window exceeded' and repeated HTTP 504 from mgmt-proxy. snippet:
```
2026-03-18T10:12:27Z mgmt-proxy error: upstream read timeout (504) - node=10.2.4.17
2026-03-18T10:12:29Z controlplane warn: ack window exceeded for slice canary-1 seq=42
```
Niko: possible cause: our canary gate requires full-slice ack before moving traffic. for air-gapped / high-jitter sites that creates head-of-line blocking across the slice
Priya S: short-term mitigation: reduce per-slice ack threshold from 20s -> 8s and allow partial-ack forwarding with threshold=50%. long-term: add per-node ack timeouts + continue rollout to healthy nodes independently
Alex M: risk: partial-ack forwarding may break split semantics for session-pinned requests. suggest we mark nodes as 'probation' (serve only new ephemeral traffic) and not fully live until full-ack
Sam G: +1. we also need better telemetry: per-node ack latency histogram in console and a rollout alert if 95p ack > 10s
Jia L: i'll open a small PR to add probation state and the metrics. quick workaround question: abort & retry with smaller slices - how disruptive for customers?
Niko: abort+retry frequently is worse (loss of canary momentum). prefer pause -> reduce slice size (1%) or toggle fallback routing to the legacy control plane for this customer
Alex M: proposed plan: pause rollout -> reduce slice to 1% -> enable partial-ack with probation marker -> monitor for 15m -> proceed. who can execute these steps?
Priya S: @Alex I can patch the rollout UX to surface a "partial-ack" toggle and a probation label. will push behind a feature flag and add docs
deploy-bot: action required: rollout paused by Alex M at 1968002401
Jia L: i'll open the PR with console mockups + metric panels, ETA ~2h
Sam G: :thumbsup: i'll add an alert rule to paging for 95p ack latency > 10s during rollouts and add a dashboard card for probationged nodes
Alex M: thanks. once PRs land we can test on staging private-vpc with injected 200-500ms jitter and validate fallback behavior
Priya S: noted — will also add a short note in the rollout runbook about partial-ack caveats for session affinity
Niko: leaving a reminder: update canary docs to explain why small slices are a safer default for air-gapped customers
Jia L: i'll tag the PRs with "rollout-probation" and link here when ready
Sam G: ping me once dashboard card exists, i'll validate alert thresholds
Alex M: ok, team. keep updates here. thanks!
